story: Linus (from LinusTechTips) builds Linus Torvald's new PC [Video]

The worth of the video is seeing how huge the CPU (1) and the cooler (2) are. 1) [VIDEO] 2) [VIDEO] Which is less surprising once one reads the specs: [LINK] "Default TDP / TDP 280W"
